framing.description: Phase 7 §7.5 bandwidth ladder: 4 rungs for a realistic 256-feature (~8KB raw float64) payload, single transaction. Real measured numbers only; PENDING cells documented with exact reason, never estimated.

rung_1_seal_seeded.description: SEAL seeded ciphertexts (Serializable<Ciphertext>, encrypt_symmetric). Halves upload at zero server cost. bank_client currently does NOT use this path -- it sends standard (public-key) ciphertexts. Confirmed by reading bank_client/bank_client.py and bank_client/he_wrapper/seal_wrapper_160.cpp: both call encrypt() (public-key), never encrypt_symmetric().
rung_1_seal_seeded.client_cpu_ms: PENDING (requires bank_client encrypt_symmetric() integration to measure)
rung_1_seal_seeded.server_cost_ms: same as rung 2 (no server-side change; server cannot distinguish wire format after deserialization)
rung_1_seal_seeded.online_latency_ms: PENDING (not deployed; would be approx. e2e_latency_ms with halved upload time)

rung_2_seal_160bit_standard.description: 160-bit chain, standard public-key ciphertext -- the CURRENT production wire format (bank_client.py -> seal_wrapper_160 -> gRPC).
rung_2_seal_160bit_standard.client_cpu_ms: included in online_latency_ms (not separately instrumented client-side)

rung_3_hhe_online_upload.description: HHE online upload: HERA-16 symmetric ciphertext for 256 features, single transaction (lanes=1). AEAD-wrapped (AES-128-GCM).
rung_3_hhe_online_upload.pending_reason: Server-side cost (BFV evaluation of HERA-16 + StC/CKKS conversion) requires the KAIST ckks_fv FV->CKKS scheme bridge, not present in standard Lattigo v6.2.0. Client-side cost (online_encrypt_ms, payload_bytes) is MEASURED.

rung_4_full_rtf.description: Full RtF: transcipher (HERA-16 eval inside BFV) + StC/CKKS conversion + existing CKKS inference circuit, end-to-end.
rung_4_full_rtf.pending_reason: Full RtF end-to-end latency cannot be measured until the KAIST ckks_fv scheme bridge is integrated (see tools/transciphering/README.md). The CKKS-only post-transcipher inference stage would reuse the existing, already-measured depth-1 circuit (artifacts/comparison_results.json, median 10.68ms for 160-bit).
